'''Tatrang V''' was the fifth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Tatrang system]],<ref name="PoG2" /> located in the [[Tammuz sector/Legends|Tammuz sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> It was a desolate mountainous world with two [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="PoG2" />
